flipToBack.timing: Two required routes: (A) one-shot check immediately after objective deployment completes; (B) required after-trigger fired by a movement completion (not a standing table state)
flipToBack.prose: Flips if (A) after start-of-game deployment no card is imprisoned in Security Tower (no Rebel was in opponent's Reserve Deck; also sets WhileInPlayData flag), OR (B) owner just moved a character escorting a frozen captive to Audience Chamber.

children.req: one-shot post-deployment card-in-zone check: NO card imprisoned in Security Tower (SetWhileInPlayDataEffect flag then FlipCardEffect)
timing trigger: owner just moved an escort escorting a frozen captive to Audience Chamber

flipToFront.timing: NEVER flips back. Back instead has a required place-out-of-play (lose) trigger on isTableChanged.
flipToFront.prose: My Favorite Decoration is placed out of play when no frozen captive can be spotted on table (SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE), unless the front's WhileInPlayData flag was set (i.e., unless no Rebel was in opponent's Reserve Deck at start of game). Guard: !GameConditions.cardHasWhileInPlayDataSet(self) && TriggerConditions.isTableChanged && GameConditions.canBePlacedOutOfPlay(game, self) && !GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE, Filters.frozenCaptive).

requirementSemantics: Flip route B is a MOVEMENT-COMPLETION timing trigger (movedToLocationBy), not a standing state: a frozen captive merely sitting at Audience Chamber does NOT flip; the escort must complete a move there while the front is up.

Flip route A is a one-shot post-deployment card-in-zone check via canSpot(imprisonedIn(Security_Tower)) with SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE; it also stamps WhileInPlayData used later by the back's out-of-play guard.

Back survival is card-on-table semantics: canSpot(SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE, Filters.frozenCaptive) anywhere on table. No control/occupy/presence check appears anywhere in either side's flip or lose law.
Back's Scum And Villainy Alter-immunity and download are gated on a frozen captive AT Audience Chamber (AtCondition / Filters.at(Filters.Audience_Chamber), SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE).
typedIdentities: Filters.Rebel (setup imprisonment target; excludes Filters.Han / Filters.Leia / Filters.Luke when opponent's objective is You Can Either Profit By This / Rescue The Princess / There Is Good In Him respectively)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Carbonite Chamber, Carbonite Chamber Console, and Security Tower from Reserve Deck (front:59-79).

If Jabba's Prize is in own Reserve Deck: required deploy of Jabba's Prize into Security Tower as imprisoned 'frozen' captive, ignoring location deployment restrictions (front:82-90). Otherwise: optional deploy by OPPONENT of a Rebel from opponent's Reserve Deck into Security Tower as imprisoned captive, with Han/Leia/Luke excluded under the matching Light objectives (front:91-113).

Front pull: once during each of your deploy phases, deploy from Reserve Deck one of Audience Chamber / Docking Bay 94 / East Platform; reshuffle. Filter Filters.or(Filters.Audience_Chamber, Filters.Docking_Bay_94, Filters.East_Platform) (front:136-155).
Back pull: once during each of your deploy phases, deploy Scum And Villainy from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) while a frozen captive is at Audience Chamber (BACK:77-93).
otherObligations: Front: owner may not deploy Dark Deal (MayNotDeployModifier, front:162).
Back: your aliens and your [Independent] starships are immune to attrition < 4 (BACK:50-51).
Back: Scum And Villainy immune to Alter while a frozen captive at Audience Chamber (ImmuneToTitleModifier + AtCondition, BACK:52-53).
Back: once during each of your control phases, retrieve 1 Force (BACK:61-75).

Back LOSE condition: placed out of play if no frozen captive on table (unless WhileInPlayData set at setup) - after flipping, Rando must keep at least one frozen captive on table permanently (BACK:100-112).

profileGaps: flipGateSite is null; the true flip gate location is Audience Chamber (a frozen captive must be MOVED there by its escort).
keyCharacterFilter is null; the flip actor is Filters.escorting(Filters.frozenCaptive) and post-flip survival depends on Filters.frozenCaptive on table - no captive concept anywhere in the profile.
No representation of the auto-flip route (no Rebel imprisoned in Security Tower after setup => immediate flip + WhileInPlayData flag).
requiredCardsOnTable is empty; the back is placed out of play when no frozen captive is on table.
Flip is a movement-completion timing trigger, not a standing control/occupy state; profile fields (flipGateSite/flipGateCardIds) cannot express this.
